[b]UPDATE 12/08/19:
[/b]Unfortunately I won't be supporting this mod anymore so there won't be any future updates, however naeldeus has updated the mod to be seasonal compatible! 

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4140]Seasonal Witchy-Gothic Cabins - naeldeus[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3982]Seasonal Witchy-Gothic Buildings - naeldeus[/url]﻿

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

I decided I wanted to have a farm that had a vaguely spooky/witch/gothic aesthetic so i made some buildings to match :-)

credit to Eemie for the wisteria I used !

UPDATE: added an alternative houses.xnb file with a bigger version of the final upgraded house

[b]UPDATE FOR 1.1: [/b]

-added a mill, shed, gold clock and recolored the junimo hut to match the silo, i didnt change the obelisks cause i think they already fit in with the theme pretty well

-changed the bigger final upgraded house to include the nice homey touches the smaller houses have

-you can choose your 'houses' version depending on whether you want a smaller final upgraded house or a bigger one and if you want the round greenhouse or the regular one (the farmhouse and greenhouse are located in the same file)

[b]INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS:

[/b]-unzip the downloaded rar file and place all the files (not the houses folder) in Content\Buildings

-choose ONE house file, i've included pngs so you can see what each houses/greenhouse combination is, and rename it 'houses.xnb' and place in Content\Buildings

ENJOY
